description: Grant proposal draft — Draft a grant proposal from a project description: title, summary, need statement, goals, objectives with measures/targets/deadlines, methods, timeline, evaluation, sustainability, budget justification and risks. Offline checks score each objective for SMART-ness, total the budget against the amount requested, and flag statistics not in your text. Optional: funder, org, amount, months. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
